summary: Finite-shot Hubbard energy, double occupancy and kinetic energy use actual grouped Born counts, matched-budget independent-Pauli baselines, exact references and Hoeffding confidence bounds. Additional exact binomial D intervals resolve the grouped D(6)-D(8) contrast at 40,960 combined preparations with CI [0.0111513,0.0464101], while Hoeffding remains unresolved there. The ungrouped binomial contrast remains unresolved even at the largest budget; both findings are exposed in studio charts, contrast cards, exports and the report. Legacy APIs remain compatible.
